name: Murata Youhei
source: Youhei is calm and collected guy that is part of princess fan club and in class 2A. Often seen with Sunao and Noriko getting along with them. Admires Otome and is part of top 5 in grade. Is teased for being only male child in family with 12 sisters. However when it comes to competition can lose his cool and become hot blooded.
